text:
frank: noticed a late-night metering gap affecting three accounts after nightly aggregator job skipped shard-9 during a GC spike. smallest impact is $6, largest is ~ $540. need guidance on supplemental invoices vs absorb as courtesy credit.

tara: can you paste the reconciliation numbers?

frank: quick totals (sanitized):
```sql
-- window 2026-03-30 02:00..02:45 UTC
select acct, count(*) from embeds_raw where shard=9 and ts between '2026-03-30 02:00' and '2026-03-30 02:45' group by acct;
-- results: MICROBOT_INC: 15,100 | NOVELTY_CO: 1,200 | ORBITAL_DATA: 1,350,000
select acct, count(*) from embeds_metered where shard=9 and ts between '2026-03-30 02:00' and '2026-03-30 02:45' group by acct;
-- results: MICROBOT_INC: 0 | NOVELTY_CO: 0 | ORBITAL_DATA: 809,000
```

ops_sam: raw log retention shows the rows exist; exporter failed to enqueue the shard segment due to GC pause. we can backfill metering from raw events.

frank: delta per account: MICROBOT_INC 15,100 -> $6.04, NOVELTY_CO 1,200 -> $0.48, ORBITAL_DATA missing 541,000 -> $216.40 (unit $0.0004).

account_kyle: ORBITAL_DATA is an enterprise seat with monthly commit and finance prefers to approve supplemental invoice rather than auto-apply credits. need legal & cfo okay. smaller two are low-effort; we usually absorb under $25.

cfo_emma: proposal: absorb MICROBOT_INC and NOVELTY_CO (internal courtesy credits) and issue supplemental invoice to ORBITAL_DATA for $216.40 with 14-day payment window. require note: "Supplemental billing for missed export due to internal aggregator GC pause; contact finance with disputes." Also require audit CSV attached.

billing.bot: Draft actions: 1) create credit memo CM-2026-0330-MICROBOT-6.04 (draft), 2) create credit memo CM-2026-0330-NOVELTY-0.48 (draft), 3) create supplemental invoice S-2026-0330-ORBITAL-216.40 (draft). All require finance finalize.

tara: legal ok on wording, no SLA impact. will cc account team on ORBITAL doc.

ops_sam: backfill ETA: 25m to repopulate metering rows and generate audit CSV. backfill will write to metering table and ledger will reflect supplementary items once finalized.

frank: CSV path (internal): s3://redwood-recon/2147012345/shard9_backfill.csv. starting backfill in 2m after approvals.

cfo_emma: approve as proposed. finalize credits for two small accounts and post supplemental invoice for ORBITAL_DATA. include memo and attach CSV.

billing.bot: Credit memos created: CM-2026-0330-MICROBOT-6.04 (posted), CM-2026-0330-NOVELTY-0.48 (posted). Supplemental invoice draft S-2026-0330-ORBITAL-216.40 created (DRAFT).

account_kyle: I will notify ORBITAL account exec to expect charge and offer to walk through the reconciliation.

ops_sam: backfill complete: metering rows inserted for shard-9 window; overrides not required. audit CSV attached to invoice draft.

billing.bot: Supplemental invoice finalized: S-2026-0330-ORBITAL-216.40. Notification queued to orbital-billing@orbital.example with attached audit CSV.

frank: closing thread. follow-up infra ticket created to add GC guardrails and nightly shard checks: INFRA-8892.
